column2: Dragged windows snap to the edges of other windows and of the screen. Hold Alt to drag freely.
Away from any edge a dragged window lines up with the inventory grid.
A faint grid appears while a window is being dragged.
Switch to the next workspace. Hold Shift for the previous one.
Open the workspace manager to switch
Each workspace keeps its own set of open containers. Switching closes one set and reopens the other where you left it.
Add an empty workspace. Switch to it and open the containers it should hold.
Close the windows of the current workspace and open these where they were.
Delete this workspace. Deleting the one you are in moves you to its neighbour first.
Open containers now and they belong to this workspace.
Empty. Switch here and open the containers it should hold.
Click to take this container out of the workspace.
This container is no longer in your shop. Click to forget it.
